purpose: Independently reviewable source-extraction, snapshot, and route-mapping attestation for the continuous SSI batch.

method.raw_source_sha256: SHA-256 of each committed sanitized source-extraction snapshot; raw account values are never committed
method.source_sha256_scope: committed sanitized source-extraction bytes captured on 2026-09-25
method.tls_certificate_verification: curl default certificate verification is enabled; no --insecure flag is used.
method.http_error_policy: --fail-with-body rejects non-2xx/3xx responses before the response can be accepted as a source snapshot.
method.route_mapping: Each ledger row is grouped by the exact Source URL in its citation; route_digest is SHA-256 over the ordered canonical route tuples.
method.fixture_digest: For every source group, extraction_fixture_sha256 is SHA-256 over the canonical per-source fixture object (sorted JSON keys).
method.snapshot_policy: The verifier and regression tests hash every committed sanitized snapshot and require exact parity with both the manifest and this attestation; route fixtures are compared to the same source groups.
